text_block_list.text:
On this day, with the Satsuki Sho just 
around the corner, a press conference was 
held with the participating runners.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
The Asahi Hai FS was especially 
impressive, but what is your mindset 
heading into the main event, the Satsuki 
Sho!?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it feels like I just have to run 
with everything I've got, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Your last race turned out to be an 
unexpected five-horse field, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yes... well...

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Word has it that her rivals avoided the 
race because Maruzensky-san was just 
overwhelmingly strong.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Winning before the race even starts... 
She truly lives up to her nickname, the 
'Supercar'!"
(Hahahaha!!)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Phew... A sudden wave of fatigue just hit 
me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I suppose she was nervous because it was a 
press conference for the Classic races, 
huh? Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, please, it's totally no problemo!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Now, more importantly, let's train..." is 
what I'd like to say, but—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"It's an awkward time of day anyway, so 
why don't we take the rest of the day off 
and go for a drive instead?"

And so, on short notice, I ended up going 
for a drive with Maruzensky—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Woo-hoo!! Going for a drive really is the 
best!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"The sound of the wind rushing past, the 
changing scenery! I feel like running 
forever!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer-kun, are you listening? Or 
rather, did you just pass out?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer-chan, are you listening? 
Or rather, did you just pass out?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's pick up the pace even 
more!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Sorry~, I got carried away and came all 
the way out here.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Still, taking Tac-chan out for a spin 
really is the best~!

Maruzensky's face was beaming with the joy 
of driving her beloved car, but—
choice_data_list: Isn't it fun to run in a race?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Well, it's pretty obvious, isn't 
it~

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I'm not really having much fun 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It was so much fun when I first debuted. 
Running at full speed, competing with 
everyone...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I've ever been so absorbed 
in running that there were days I didn't 
even go for a drive.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
However, right beside me having fun, the 
other girls were running with completely 
different feelings...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You saw it too, right? The look on that 
girl's face when she had to withdraw from 
the race in such pain.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You saw it too, right? The look on that 
girl's face when she had to withdraw from 
the race in such pain.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"In the end, I ran out of people to run 
against, so even I couldn't enjoy running 
anymore."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...I know I shouldn't be saying things 
like this with the Classics right around 
the corner, but...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Maybe... I shouldn't be running...

"It's better not to run"—she must have 
felt that way during her previous race as 
well.

Still, it's also true that I was 
captivated by her running and decided to 
become her trainer...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The opposite...? You mean it's better if I 
do run?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But as a result, everyone ended up 
avoiding the race...
choice_data_list: What do you like about your car?

What do you love most about your beloved 
car?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Tac-chan...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I love the overwhelming speed 
and acceleration, and the aerodynamic form 
that makes you feel one with the wind.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
She's packed full of charms you'd never 
get from an ordinary car.
choice_data_list: The same goes for your running.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...My running is the same...
choice_data_list:
There's something I want you to see—let's 
head back to the academy!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Wait, huh!? What's going on...!?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what is it you wanted to show me, 
anyway...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, oh? Someone's running at this 
hour...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whew... *pant*... *whimper*...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: You set a new record, Spe-chan~

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Really!? Yay~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If I keep building my skills like this, 
I'll be able to debut real soon, huh...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And then, I'm gonna become an Umamusume 
who can stand right alongside 
Maruzen-san!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, merely running side by side might 
not be enough to satisfy me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Now, please time my run next.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Good luck, Grass-chan!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Those girls...

While it's true some Umamusume are 
overwhelmed by Maruzensky, they are—
choice_data_list:
I'm running because I want to catch up to 
you.

I'm running because I want to catch up to 
you.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"...You stayed up this late just for 
that?"

Looking at her junior's dedication, 
there's no doubt that Maruzensky's running 
holds incredible appeal—
choice_data_list:
Let's show them a run that makes everyone 
want to chase our backs!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, someone everyone wants to chase 
after... huh. You really are interesting.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, someone everyone wants to chase 
after... huh. You really are interesting.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Still... it's strange how dependable 
you've become.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Isn't it wonderful? To have everyone 
chasing after me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... Understood. I'll put my trust in 
you, Trainer-kun."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... Understood. I'll put my trust in 
you, Trainer-chan."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I'll put on such an overwhelming run that 
everyone won't be able to help but chase 
after me!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yes! Let's blast off at full throttle!

And so, mentally prepared for the Satsuki 
Sho, Maruzensky was ready.
